frontier.label: Arithmetic-to-zero-location rigidity
frontier.target: Exploit the verified joint mass and log-moment coupling to prove the centered arithmetic remainder cannot undercut the convex reserve, uniformly enough to make every canonical gap nonnegative, then derive an unconditional zero-location constraint

goal: A complete Lean-verified proof of the Riemann hypothesis

milestones.label: Boundary heat vanishing is equivalent to RH
Poisson decay is equivalent to sublinear cumulative upper spectral height
Canonical Suzuki gap has a square-root-scale convex-plus-PNT asymptotic

statusNote: Cutoffs zero and one are proved. The normalized literal gap equals 4(exp(delta_N/2)-1-delta_N/2) plus the normalized centered PNT remainder plus o(1). The remainder is now exactly E_log(N)-r_N E_mass(N) for weighted Chebyshev log-moment and mass errors from the same arithmetic measure, while E_mass(N)/sqrt N equals 2(exp(delta_N/2)-1)+o(1). A joint sign or covariance estimate protecting the convex reserve and every RH-forcing rigidity step remain open.
